SWSEMOBILE.Play.Title: Play View
SWSEMOBILE.Play.NoVariable: This entry carries no roll variable, so there is nothing to roll.
SWSEMOBILE.Settings.SilenceResolutionWar: Below 1024x768 Foundry raises a permanent error banner. Nothing is actually disabled by it, and on a phone its text is misleading (it blames a zoom factor, because every handset reports devicePixelRatio > 1). This dismisses the banner; the issue stays visible in Game Settings / Support Details.
SWSEMOBILE.Settings.PlaySheetOnSmallScre: Open the Play View on phones
On a viewport narrower than 700px, opening an actor you own raises the compact Play View and minimises the full sheet. The full sheet stays one tap away.
SWSEMOBILE.Settings.PlayViewHeaderButton: Play View button in the sheet header

Adding a header control shifts the other controls and shortens the window title, so on a desktop it changes the sheet you already know. "Automatic" therefore shows it only on touch devices. The Actors sidebar right-click menu always offers the Play View regardless of this setting.
